<<<JSON
{ "summary": "Scaffolded the real web/ project (package.json, tsconfig, vite.config.ts, index.html) with Preact, idb and Vitest; copied styles.css byte-identical from the sketch, added a minimal main.tsx placeholder and a smoke test. All four gate commands (install, typecheck, test, build) pass, and the placeholder renders correctly in the dark theme at 1280 and 375 px.", "notes_for_reviewer": "Used current package versions as instructed: vitest ^5.1.1 and fake-indexeddb ^6.2.8 (plan examples said '^4' for vitest but told me to check the current major — 5.1.1 is current). A stray untracked web/dist/ left over from the sketch phase existed before this task and was deleted before building fresh; not a tracked file so no git history was touched. Did not port core.ts/ui.tsx/seed.ts — those belong to later tasks per the plan." }
JSON>>>
